ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, fair value (gains) losses on equity and limited partnership investments, impairments and other charges, pension settlement losses, acquisition-related items, product-line disposition gains and contract settlement expense, then deducts the aggregate tax effect and removes discrete tax items. MCPS: per-share adjustments assume all MCPS converted ('if-converted' regardless of dilution); adjusted diluted shares = GAAP diluted shares + converted shares of anti-dilutive MCPS, and the related MCPS dividends are added back. Adjusted diluted shares 746.0m (737.4m + 8.6m MCPS B converted shares). IS shows 'Other operating expenses' line (— in Q3-22; 547 contract settlement in Q3-21). Item amounts from release footnotes. Release FCF table three-month only.
